material_description: CX800 | N-doped zeolite 13X-templated carbon, CVD of acetonitrile at 800 C for 3 h, HF/HCl washed, N content 6 wt%
purification_method: 10% HF washes, then reflux in conc. HCl at 60 C to remove zeolite; dried at 120 C (TGA residue typically <3% at 800 C)
functional_groups: pyridine-like N (N1s 398.6 eV) and quaternary N (400.5 eV), XPS of CX samples (Figure 5)
source_location: Supporting Information Figure 1S (p. 2), curve (e) CX800, digitized markers

extractor: dual extraction A (claude-sonnet-5-5) and B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)

purification_method: 10% HF washes, then reflux in conc. HCl at 60 C to remove zeolite; dried at 120 C (TGA residue typically <3% at 800 C)
source_location: Supporting Information Figure 1S (p. 2), curve (f) CX850, digitized markers
notes: IGA-003 (Hiden) gravimetric; degassing under vacuum to 10^-10 bar (printed) at 200 C overnight (duration not given); SI Figure 1S: sample density 1.5 g/cm3 used, no buoyancy correction for adsorbed H2 applied; BET range: P/Po 0.02-0.25; surface area and pore volume from N2 sorption at -196 C (Table 1 values in parentheses are micropore surface area and micropore volume, method not named); skeletal (He) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 given for the carbon materials generally; temperature printed -196 C; pressure and uptake are the digitized marker centre; markers at about 2 bar and below overlap and are not extracted, isotherm_point_count (markers at 2.5-19 bar every 0.5 bar plus end marker) is a lower bound; marker shapes alternate and the paper does not say which are adsorption or desorption, all coded adsorption; end marker at about 20 bar is a separate measurement of the uncorrected isotherm, not Table 1 (Table 1 values include the adsorbed-H2 buoyancy correction); markers of curves e and f merge at 2.5 and 3.5 bar and are not extracted; archive: Fig1S_f_CX850.json; C (reconciliation): value and pressure are the mean of the A and B digitizations of this marker (B row HYC-0117-M175, archive fig1S_red.json); digitization_uncertainty = max(half difference, 1% of the 0-4 wt% axis span).
extractor: dual extraction A (claude-sonnet-5-5) and B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)
free_volume_calibration: buoyancy correction for the sample only: He (skeletal) density 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA; no correction for adsorbed H2

purification_method: washed with 10% HF several times, refluxed in concentrated HCl at 60 °C to remove the zeolite, dried at 120 °C (TGA residual mass typically <3% at 800 °C)
source_location: Figure 10A (main p.7), curve b (CX850, volumetric)
notes: BET range: 0.02−0.25 (N2, −196 °C). Total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 ca. 0.99; micropore area and micropore volume (Table 1 parentheses) method not stated. Temperature printed as −196 °C. Skeletal (helium) density ca. 1.5 g/cm3 measured with the IGA, stated for the carbon samples in general. Volumetric, Micromeritics ASAP 2020; evacuated at 200 °C under vacuum overnight; free-volume determination not described. Basis not named; basis_inferred excess by the volumetric default. archive: fig10A_black.json. Curve assignment made by position (both curves black). isotherm_point_count includes markers merged with neighbours and one triangle at (0, ~0.02 wt%) of uncertain curve. The paper reports no hysteresis and the plotted runs may include desorption points (blue curves alternate up and down triangles) but does not say which markers are desorption; all coded adsorption. C (reconciliation): marker on Figure 10A curve (b) at about 1.07 bar resolved only by B (A's digitization stopped at 1.0 bar); kept with B's value and 1% of the 0-2 wt% axis span; assigned to A's isotherm I20 and sample HYC-0117-S3.
extractor: dual extraction A (claude-sonnet-5-5) and B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)
